svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":9,"chapter":"Ch.9 · The Fall of Jerusalem","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The city falls after a long siege; the king's sons are slain, the temple is burned, and the people are taken into exile.
